question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will make it logically complete.

F_HTFKO_ _RVTFY_TF_JT
solution:
**Given :** F_HTFKO_ _RVTFY_TF_JT

By checking options :

 
• UJHNH → F__U__HTFKO__J__ __H__RVTFY__N__TF__H__JT → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• DHJNF → F__D__HTFKO__H__ __J__RVTFY__N__TF__F__JT → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• JFJMH → F__J__HTFKO__F__ __J__RVTFY__M__TF__H__JT → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• DTFCF → F__D__HTFKO__T__ __**F**__RVTFY__C__TF__F__JT → (It follows the pattern of : [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9649773c226b80dfb19fa0e6b9ba11c624a69eaaf18c854f4523101b17d84c6.png] 

Hence, "**DTFCF**" is the correct answer.
